notes:
Inbound from marketing automation webinar — product + growth teams. Primary ask: scale high-volume content generation for templates and SEO articles while keeping unit costs low. Short summary of needs and asks:
- Workload: template-driven generation + periodic bulk jobs (daily/weekly). Expect 3M–7M generated tokens/day initially; seasonal spikes up to 12M tokens/day.
- Latency: not ultra-low but want 95th percentile <250ms for short completions (social posts/email snippets); longer article jobs can be async/batched.
- Cost sensitivity: must keep avg gen cost under ~$0.0008/token to hit unit economics. Very interested in batching and prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token compute.
- Model preference: open/Redwood-verified models acceptable; want quantized variants for cost. Prefer ability to route to cheaper variant for non-critical outputs, fallback to higher-quality for critical flows.
- Deployment: hosting in public cloud; self-serve hosted API is preferred for speed to market.
- Security/compliance: requires SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logs for user activity; retention controls desirable.
- Integrations: billing integration w/ Stripe, webhook for job completion, and per-route rate limiting.
- Quote from product lead: "We need predictable token costs more than bleeding-edge quality — speed and price beat tiny quality gains for 95% of our workloads."
- POC ask: 15-day sandbox with workload replay (we will share sample CSV of prompts), sample cost sheet showing batching + caching impact, example configs for continuous batching and streaming.
- Other notes: customer hit free-tier rate limits during smoke test; asked if burst capacity is available and how long to increase quota. We sent initial pricing deck and POC checklist (drive links above).
